text: As required by the City's Investment Policy, the purpose of this report is to provide the Toronto Investment Board ("Board") with the following: 1. The performance of the Sinking Fund and Long Term Fund for the first quarter of 2023. 2. Investment Policy and Plan Compliance certificates and reports for the first quarter of 2023.
The Toronto Investment Board received the report (June 1, 2023) from the Director, Capital Markets for information.
